label: VERIFIED
extraction: Verification Loop six phases with commands and pass/fail criteria. Phase 1 Build: npm run build / pnpm build - if fails STOP and fix. Phase 2 Type Check: npx tsc --noEmit / pyright - report all type errors, fix critical. Phase 3 Lint: npm run lint / ruff check - report warnings. Phase 4 Test Suite: npm run test -- --coverage - target 80% minimum coverage, report total/passed/failed/coverage%. Phase 5 Security Scan: grep for 'sk-', 'api_key', 'console.log' in source files. Phase 6 Diff Review: git diff --stat, git diff HEAD~1 --name-only - review each changed file for unintended changes, missing error handling, potential edge cases. Output: VERIFICATION REPORT with PASS/FAIL per phase, overall READY/NOT READY. Continuous mode: run every 15 minutes or after major changes (after each function, component, before next task).
